name: KTM 690 Enduro R
engine: 654 or 690 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected
intro: A powerful single-cylinder dual-sport. Fuel pump failures are the most reported problem.

add.title: Check the fuel pump and filter
add.instructions: Check fuel pressure and the in-tank filter. Look for black residue in the tank from a worn pump. Don't run the tank dry.
add.reason: Fuel pump failure is one of the most common 690 problems, and a dying pump can clog the filter and injector.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Fuel pump
known.what: Fuel pump failure is one of the most common 690 Enduro R problems.
